title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 20
description:
Embrace your love for baseball with this personalized baseball comforter set from Jeminise. Perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers, this bedding set combines comfort with a unique, custom design, making it an ideal gift for any occasion.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Designed for baseball enthusiasts, celebrating determination and passion for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin, Full, Queen, and King sizes to fit various bed dimensions.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features an environmental protection finishing process for vibrant, fade-resistant colors and smooth, compact stitching for lasting durability.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling, ensuring a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight sleeping experience.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and dries quickly for convenient maintenance.
  • Personalized Design: Customize with your name for a unique touch, making it a truly special bedding set.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, perfect for refreshing your bedroom decor.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Set Name Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Special Feature Breathable
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Included Components Duvet Cover
Thread Count 400
